759eb418-e6cb-4cf9-a66f-5a943e089ef9.col_schema:
Column: REQID
Type: string
Summary: Unique identifier for each requirement (e.g., REQID1).

Column: Title
Type: string
Summary: Short name or title of the requirement being specified.

Column: Description
Type: string
Summary: Detailed explanation of the requirement, its purpose, and regulatory context.

Column: AS IS
Type: string
Summary: Description of the current state or existing process (e.g., bank currently only issues Visa/Mastercard).

Column: TO BE
Type: string
Summary: Intended future state or target process once the requirement is implemented.

Column: Pre-requisite
Type: string
Summary: Conditions or setup needed before implementing the requirement.

Column: Acceptance Criteria
Type: string
Summary: Conditions that must be met to consider the requirement successfully implemented.

Column: Alternate Flows
Type: string
Summary: Variations or alternative paths/scenarios related to the requirement.
